definitions.definition: The periodic change of the sea level, caused by the gravitational pull of the Moon and Sun.
definitions.example: the changing patterns of the tides

definitions.definition: Time, notably anniversary, period or season linked to an ecclesiastical feast.
To cause to float with the tide.
To pour a tide or flood.
To work into or out of a river or harbor by drifting with the tide.
Extra sense that should be capped.
